draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.28, the 70th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 6th of 20 at DT. He went 71st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Davon Godchaux. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (89th percentile), three-cone (88th percentile), bench press (86th percentile). College production: 6 sacks in 2019, 6th of 20 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Baltimore Ravens. 78 career games and 66 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 15 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (12th percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-6 interior lineman who played: 4 pressures against a median of 5, below the norm.
